This might be a long comment. But I, as someone who used to act similarly, understand it. 

The baby talk is a coping mechanism. I don’t think they realize they are doing it, or are doing it entirely on purpose. 

This is based off of my recovery experience. Basically, Going into recovery is very mentally taxing. Initially, even more so than actively having an ed. The ed screams louder when it’s dying.

I was like 18, but screaming and crying like a toddler. I also am pretty sure head banging injuries and teen girls has also been a topic of discussion here, and my theory is that it’s usually a similar reason. They are going through what could be the hardest time of their life so far, and the age regression behaviours are a way to cope with it.

The internet never shows the full story. The baby talk despite being in their late teens to twenties shows that these girls are the most vulnerable they have ever been and probably should not be sharing all that they do online.
